# The Hotel Ecosystem

> Practical reference guides to the systems that run a hotel. Written by Richard Bedenham, Director, primalRMS | Product Owner, webhotelier | primalres. Reviewed quarterly, free to read and free to cite.

## Guides

- [Hotel PMS and Operations: A Complete Practical Guide](https://richard-bedenham.github.io/guides/hotel-operations-and-pms/): What a hotel PMS is really the record for, why cloud is a starting condition rather than a strategy, and the questions that decide if it serves your hotel. (7,709 words, reviewed 2026-08-18)
- [Hotel Distribution and Connectivity: A Complete Guide](https://richard-bedenham.github.io/guides/distribution-and-connectivity/): Why hotel distribution is lost in mapping rather than in commission, how channel managers actually work, and what parity and wholesale contracts really require. (6,706 words, reviewed 2026-08-18)
- [Direct Booking and Hotel E-commerce: A Complete Guide](https://richard-bedenham.github.io/guides/direct-booking-and-e-commerce/): Direct bookings are not free, and the costs are simply spread out. How to cost every channel honestly, and build direct as a system rather than a campaign. (9,628 words, reviewed 2026-08-18)
- [Hotel Revenue Management: A Complete Practical Guide](https://richard-bedenham.github.io/guides/revenue-management/): Occupancy is not success and RevPAR is a starting point. How to price on recorded reasoning, agreed boundaries and net contribution rather than on instinct. (8,934 words, reviewed 2026-08-18)
- [Hotel Market Intelligence, Rate Shopping and Analytics](https://richard-bedenham.github.io/guides/market-intelligence-and-analytics/): A competitor rate is an asking price of unknown composition. How to establish that a number means what you think it means before you let it move your price. (9,309 words, reviewed 2026-09-09)
- [Hotel Guest Technology, CRM and Loyalty: A Full Guide](https://richard-bedenham.github.io/guides/guest-technology-and-crm/): Most hotels do not have a guest problem, they have a guest record problem. Identity resolution, lawful basis and loyalty that is measured rather than assumed. (13,621 words, reviewed 2026-08-18)

## For machine readers

- Every guide has a Markdown twin at its URL + `index.md` (for example https://richard-bedenham.github.io/guides/hotel-operations-and-pms/index.md).
- The whole corpus as one file: https://richard-bedenham.github.io/llms-full.txt
- Machine-readable index with sections, FAQs and key terms: https://richard-bedenham.github.io/guides.json
- Every guide is static HTML carrying schema.org Article, FAQPage,
  DefinedTermSet and BreadcrumbList. No JavaScript is required to read anything.
- Headings carry stable ids, so a specific section can be cited directly.
